Hi Camila,

Thanks again for the demo earlier today — the team liked the latency numbers and the routing options. Our security team is starting intake for vendor review. Can you share the SIG/CAIQ or your standard security questionnaire to get started?

Couple of immediate questions from InfoSec:
- Do you have a current SOC 2 Type II report? If so, what is the period covered?
- Any HIPAA experience / BAA available?
- Are you able to provide a list of subprocessors?

We'd like to kick off the formal questionnaire this week. Primary contacts are me (InfoSec) and Bob (Procurement).

Best,
Alice Johnson
Head of InfoSec
AcmeHealth
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: SIG Questionnaire initiation - AcmeHealth

Hi Alice — thanks for the note and great to hear the demo was useful. I attached our SIG/CAIQ template to get started (SIG_Questionnaire_Template_v2.pdf). Quick answers up front:

- SOC 2: We have a SOC 2 Type II report (CY 2026 coverage). I can share a summary and the report under an NDA / secure link — see follow-up.
- HIPAA / BAA: We support HIPAA workloads and can execute a BAA; I'll loop in Legal for execution.
- Subprocessors: I'll attach the current subprocessor list and surface any questions; if you need a full vendor map we can provide that as well.

A few clarifying questions so we can prioritize sections of the SIG:
1) Integration model: will AcmeHealth use Redwood via API calls to our hosted endpoint, or are you planning a private/dedicated deployment (VPC/on-prem)?
2) Data sensitivity: will the integration include PHI? If yes, are there specific retention requirements or encryption at rest mandates beyond standard FIPS/KMS?
3) Expected scale: average concurrent generate calls and peak QPS — helps with performance/security controls we emphasize.
4) Evidence: do you require raw logs / access to audit trails or are redacted summaries sufficient for initial review?

Next steps I propose: 1) You complete the attached SIG template where comfortable, 2) we schedule a 30-min technical follow-up next week to clarify integration details, and 3) I'll share our SOC 2 summary and subprocessor list via a secure link.

Looping in Marissa (security ops) on the thread for any additional evidence requests.

Thanks —
Camila Reyes
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com

Thanks Camila — attaching initial responses as we start to gather details on our end (we'll send a completed SIG by end of week). Quick clarifications:

- Integration model: API (hosted) to start. We might evaluate dedicated later but initial PoC is via your hosted API.
- Data sensitivity: integration will include PHI (clinical notes + identifiers). We will need a signed BAA and confirmation of HIPAA controls.
- Scale: small POC initially (~5-10 concurrent requests, <100 QPS peak).
- Evidence: for initial review, a SOC 2 summary and auditor opinion are fine; later we may request redacted logs.

Also: can you confirm encryption at rest for customer data, whether you use KMS, and whether key management supports customer-managed keys?

Thanks —
Alice
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@acmehealth.com>, Bob Lee <bob.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 14:03:00 -07:00

Hi Alice / Bob — appreciate the quick clarifications. Answers below and I've attached a short SOC 2 summary (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf) and a link to our secure evidence folder: https://redwood.app/drive/soc2-summary

- SOC 2: Yes, SOC 2 Type II for CY 2026. Summary attached; full report available under NDA / secure transfer.
- HIPAA / BAA: We support HIPAA workloads and can execute a BAA. I'll have Legal start the BAA draft and loop you in.
- Encryption: Data is encrypted at rest using AES-256. We use cloud KMS for key management; customer-managed keys (BYOK) are supported on our Dedicated and Private deployments. For hosted API customers, we offer managed KMS with options for customer key escrow in enterprise plans — we can discuss details in the tech call.
- Subprocessors: current subprocessor list attached to the evidence folder; we'll include a CSV export if helpful.
- Logs / Evidence: we can provide audit trail excerpts and redacted logs for initial review. For deeper requests we coordinate with Security Ops (Marissa) and Legal.

Next steps:
1) I'll redeploy the SIG template with our answers where helpful and send the file over (or we can review it together on the tech call).
2) Proposed tech call: Tue 18 May, 10:00-10:30 PT. Does that work?
3) I'll start an NDA/secure link for the SOC 2 report and ask Legal to begin the BAA draft.

If that works I'll send calendar invites and the evidence link.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
